The Firm employs certified public accountants who can support our clients in various areas, including:
• Preparation and issuance of certificates evidencing debts that have been capitalized in Mexican companies in exchange for share issuance, in compliance with the requirements established by the tax authorities for such transactions.
• Preparation and issuance of tax reports ("dictámenes fiscales") relating to the sale of shares issued by Mexican companies by individuals and legal entities residing abroad, enabling access to reduced withholding rates under Mexico's international tax treaties—or, alternatively, to pay tax on the gain realized—thereby optimizing the effect with the tax basis of the shares sold.
• Preparation and issuance of tax reports ("dictámenes fiscales") related to the sale of shares carried out by individuals residing in Mexico, allowing them to benefit from lower withholding rates on the gain obtained in the transaction.
